section_summary.extract_value: This section reports further analyses of body appreciation (mean of 10 BAS-2 items) from the primary sample (gender comparisons and correlations) and additional analyses using data obtained from Swami & Ng (2015) (Cantonese vs Standard Chinese versions; women n=457, men n=417). It highlights gender-specific correlations between body appreciation and BMI in the primary sample (women r = -0.19; men r = -0.13) and ANCOVA results comparing language versions and sex in the Swami & Ng sample.
